name: marketing-faqs
title: FAQs
description: Accordion-style FAQ sections for marketing landing pages and support pages, letting visitors expand answers to common questions without leaving the page, with chevron, divided, and background-styled variants.
useWhen: Answering common pre-sales questions on a pricing or product landing page to reduce support inquiries.
Building a lightweight FAQ or help section without a full knowledge base.
Structuring common objections and answers in a conversion-focused page flow.
avoidWhen: More than 15–20 questions are needed — use a searchable knowledge base or docs site instead.
Answers contain rich formatting (code, tables, images) — a dedicated help article layout is more appropriate.
All answers should be visible simultaneously — use a simple list or definition list instead.
responsiveBehavior: FAQ sections are full-width at all viewports. Accordion items stack vertically and expand without horizontal overflow. Text wraps naturally within expanded answers at all widths.
accessibility: Use native <details>/<summary> elements for zero-JavaScript keyboard-accessible disclosure — no ARIA widget needed.
Question text inside <summary> should be wrapped in a heading or have sufficient visual hierarchy.
Expanded answers must not be hidden from the accessibility tree when open.

variants.title: Base with chevrons
variants.description: Bordered FAQ accordion with a rotating chevron icon on each question — the standard collapsible FAQ pattern for landing pages.
accessibility: Native <details>/<summary> provides keyboard-accessible expand/collapse; no JavaScript required.

variants.title: Base with chevrons (Dark)
variants.description: Chevron-style FAQ accordion adapted for dark marketing page surfaces.
accessibility: Question and answer text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark accordion backgrounds.

variants.title: Divided with chevrons
variants.description: FAQ accordion where each question is separated by a horizontal divider rather than a card border — a lighter, text-forward style.
accessibility: Divider lines are decorative; <details>/<summary> semantics remain unchanged.

variants.title: Divided with chevrons (Dark)
variants.description: Divider-separated FAQ accordion adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Divider colors and question text must meet contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Background
variants.description: FAQ accordion with a distinct background color or section background — used when the FAQ is embedded in a section that needs visual separation from the surrounding page.
accessibility: Background-colored section must maintain WCAG AA contrast between question text, divider, and the section background.

variants.title: Background (Dark)
variants.description: Background-section FAQ accordion adapted for dark marketing page surfaces.
accessibility: Section background and question text contrast must be maintained on dark page surfaces.
